statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Current Tail remains low while NQ is weekend-closed; Stress is extreme as the Saudi pipeline outage and weaker Saudi equities increase reopening and macro risk.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Path-based evidence becomes available at the scheduled Globex reopening; gap persistence, retracement quality and cross-asset alignment will determine whether conditional WATCH risk is reinforced or fades.
headline: Saudi pipeline outage and Gulf-market weakness keep stress extreme before NQ reopens
body: NQ is weekend-closed, so persistent one-way Nasdaq price-path evidence is unavailable. Reuters reports Saudi shares down sharply after the pipeline attack and says the outage could threaten up to 4% of global oil supply if not restored promptly. These developments raise gap, inflation and yield stress without proving persistent mean-reversion failure.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding UTC clock hours have published ChatGPT assessments. Tail stayed at 19%; Stress moved from 99% to 100% as Gulf energy-route disruption intensified, while Confidence remained 98% and dominantMode stayed normal.
outlookSummary: Conditional risk is concentrated from 19:00 UTC through the early post-reopen hours. Forecast Tail peaks at 24% WATCH around Globex because the future price path is unobserved; 25%+ would require actual persistent extension, failed retracements or multiple aligned current amplifiers.

One hour before Globex, conditional Tail rises further within WATCH. The first decisive test is whether any opening gap develops two-way trade or instead converts into repeated directional extension.

At the scheduled Globex reopening, WATCH peaks conditionally. Tail remains below the block threshold unless actual trading shows persistent extension, failed retracements, session-extreme holding or several aligned current amplifiers.

forecast.analysis: In the first post-open hour, WATCH remains conditionally high. Two-way rotation and meaningful pullbacks would argue against escalation; repeated extension after weak retracements would be the adverse path.
If early reopening volatility begins to retrace, conditional Tail can ease while Stress stays extreme. Continued one-way extension near the session extreme would invalidate that easing path.

forecast.analysis: If meaningful pullbacks develop by this hour, WATCH can continue easing. A delayed second directional leg after failed retracements would keep Tail near the upper WATCH band.
Conditional Tail falls toward the bottom of WATCH if price discovery becomes two-sided. Persistent energy and yield pressure can keep Stress extreme even without a pathological Nasdaq path.
drivers: Energy and yield pressure may sustain Stress

forecast.analysis: Tail returns to low only if post-reopen trading has shown genuine retracements or otherwise lacks persistent directional efficiency. Stress can remain extreme because the energy-supply shock is still unresolved.

forecast.analysis: If overnight NQ remains rotational rather than one-way, low Tail is maintained. Renewed geopolitical escalation or repeated extension would be the main conditions that challenge this baseline.

forecast.analysis: Low Tail persists conditionally if Asia-hour trading shows normal pullbacks and no sustained hold at a session extreme. Stress remains extreme while the energy supply disruption is unresolved.
If the overnight session remains two-sided, Stress can edge below its ceiling while Tail stays low. A renewed oil or yield spike combined with aligned NQ extension would reverse that improvement.

forecast.analysis: Approaching Europe, low Tail assumes no persistent overnight trend has formed. Cross-asset alignment would matter materially only if accompanied by actual NQ extension and weak retracements.
If Europe opens without reinforcing a one-way Nasdaq path, Tail remains low and Stress can ease modestly. Persistent directional efficiency would invalidate this conditional baseline.
